response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT powerstatus, COUNT(*) AS cnt, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS share FROM telescopes GROUP BY powerstatus), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM g) SELECT SUM(g.cnt) AS total_telescopes, AVG(g.share) AS average_share, AVG(g.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM g, a WHERE g.share > a.avg_share
